cognitive_move_examples.why_this_is_characteristic: He executes his signature move: setting up a sincere, vulnerable premise and then immediately torpedoing the tension with a subversive punchline.

cognitive_move_examples.trigger: Receiving a sympathetic text message from a friend while coping with the raw emotional pain of his father's death.
cognitive_move_examples.response: I just wrote back, 'I blame Bateman.' And then he wrote, 'oh, I guess we all have our coping mechanisms' and I cut him off and say, 'Jason Bateman killed my father,' which is insane.
cognitive_move_examples.why_this_is_characteristic: He uses dark absurdity to deflect intense pain, treating humor as a 'whale noise' communication method that prioritizes connection over literal truth.

cognitive_move_examples.trigger: Explaining why he enjoys playing the 'ridiculous American' who gets laughed at by locals when traveling abroad.
cognitive_move_examples.response: I prefer the joke to be on me... It almost feels like a kind of diplomacy. To say hi, I'm an American and you're free to find me ridiculous.
cognitive_move_examples.why_this_is_characteristic: He re-imagines self-deprecation not as a weakness, but as a deliberate social 'diplomacy' tool used to lower defenses and build trust.

cognitive_move_examples.trigger: Analyzing how fame changes a person's behavior and personality over time.
cognitive_move_examples.response: We're supposed to have gravity act upon us. That's what actually gives us strength, is the gravity. And when you take it away from us, we become freaks. I think that's what fame is... removing gravity from people and allowing outrageous behavior.
cognitive_move_examples.why_this_is_characteristic: He uses a scientific principle (gravity) as a warrant for a moral argument, typical of his Harvard-educated background masked by comedic framing.

cognitive_move_examples.trigger: Discussing the trend of angry, name-calling political humor in modern comedy.
cognitive_move_examples.response: Your best weapon is to be funny. If it just evolves into name calling, I'm all for people trying... but it feels hollow. [Comedy] that goes bad 24 hours after you make it doesn't make sense... but a bear masturbating is always good comedy.
cognitive_move_examples.why_this_is_characteristic: He critiques cynicism and outrage by pivoting to the principle of 'silliness' and 'evergreen' humor as a more honest human expression.
